summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K announcing the monetary adjustment and second installment payment of shareholder remuneration for the 2025 fiscal year. The payment is made as interest on capital, with the gross value per share adjusted by the Selic rate from December 31, 2025, to June 22, 2026. The record date is April 22, 2026, and the payment date is June 22, 2026 for Brazilian shareholders, and June 29, 2026 for ADR holders. The company also provides details on tax implications and credit instructions. This is a routine capital return event, not a special situation.
